## Cannot be tested at LP2's effect size

| Item | Finding |
|---|---|
| **Two-tap echo rules (copy or affine image of the rune 5 and 6 back, inside words) and rewrites of plaintext repeats** | Not excluded; not testable on LP2 alone; leaves the key layer untouched |
| **Evolving-alphabet walk (period-5 alphabets per word, alphabet changes per word, skip on repeat; aldegonde's length-clocked walk)** | The one family the fingerprint leaves standing, and no test has power for it *(The scan detects copy rates of 6%; LP2 shows 1.5%)* |
| **Key reuse between sections (two-time pad under skip drift)** | Undecidable from the ciphertext *(Power 0.05-0.42 for a planted full-section reuse)* |

|---|---|
| **Transcription and corrections** | An independent OCR re-read confirms the LP2 transcription. Corrections: one rune-order error on a solved page (BELIEVE); 5 byte errors in the 256-byte payload (3 also in Dukotah's canon_256.bin); no merged doublets anywhere; word boundaries authentic (0 of 2,334 transcribed word dots missing) |
| **Doublet deficit: 0.63% of adjacent pairs against 3.45% expected** | 81% enforcement (the skip / coin anti-repeat rule); boundary-blind; the surviving in-word doublets are consistent with the coin model (G 3.0 against 9.4 for uniform; informational, one synthetic control) |
| **Within-word lag-5 echo** | z +3.7 (calibrated P 0.007), carried by the rune S (11 of 102 coincidences); strictly word-internal and flat over the position in the word: a mechanism must know where words begin and end. 2026-10-18: hits spread over sections and vocabulary (no hit-bearing word repeats, 0/93), multi-hit words 9 vs 3.05 (Poisson p 0.004, confounded with source concentration), the 11 S,S pairs: 3 word-final, 4 at word position 0 |
| **Within-word lag-6 relation c' = 24 - 2c** | z +5.0 (P 0.005-0.013 after the look-elsewhere correction, split-half replicates); strictly word-internal. 2026-10-18: the excess is entirely the residual cell r = 0 (chi2 64.9 vs null max 67.7 over 6496 affine settings); the rate 0.0272 +/- 0.0047 equals the avoided-collision rate with corrected section Pearson r=+0.328993 for deficit and -0.328993 for fixed-q, eight contributing sections (old r=-0.38, n=9 was defective; uncertainty unknown); named source mechanisms (F-replacement, W3(a) twist, autokey chain) excluded |
| **Word lengths: no serial structure, fewer 2-rune words than English** | 2-rune words 15.5% against 20-27% in English (rejected in runes, p about 10^-45); best simple fit: one extra rune in about 42% of multi-rune words (G 16.5, df 10, p 0.085); spelling TH as T + H explains most of it (G 223 -> 56) |
| **Flat unigrams and bigrams, no coincidence peak at any lag, no literal-F excess, repeated 6-gram DJU-BEI** | 458 ciphertext F against 447 +/- 21 expected (z +0.5): LP2 does not follow the solved pages' literal-F convention in one layer; the repeated 6-gram DJU-BEI has chance probability 0.16 (P(>= 1)). 2026-10-18 sharper finding: DJU and BEI are two 3-rune words, each occurring exactly twice, always as the adjacent pair DJU->BEI - the ONLY repeated adjacent word-pair in all 2,887 pairs of LP2 (within-section word-shuffle null: P(any pair >= 2 occurrences) = 0.016, P(DJU->BEI >= 2) = 0 of 1000), and the second occurrence is the book's final two words (0.15 ends ... CEAIMCX DJU BEI) |

Conditional Bernoulli site null, not exact forward cipher. Pure-null selected-lag6-affine optimism +26.54 counts does not correct 80 (zero fixed-T6/tail matches). NEW fixed-rule controls: I5 2/2 per half, T6 1/2 in A and 2/2 in B, null clear; coarse gates pass. 27/27 fixed-halves tests per invocation. Subsequent dispersion controls: 0/4 Bernoulli flags, 4/4 evenly spaced flags with matched total and one-site marginals; 28/28 tests per invocation.
